[SWS_DM_00099] Supported Service SID level checks
⌈
The Diagnos-
tic Server instance shall check, whether there is a configured internal or ex-
ternal service processor for the incoming diagnostic request. If there is no service
processor on SID level, the Verification shall be considered as failed and the negative
response code shall be 0x11 (serviceNotSupported)
⌋
